s.p.espaces.sos_women: Ka hoʻomāinoino i nā wahine (e kamaʻilio ana, manuahi, ʻole)
s.p.espaces.sos_deaf: Hoʻopiʻi ma o ka leka uila (nā poʻe pōkole a i ʻole nā ​​poʻe e hiki ʻole ke kamaʻilio)
s.p.espaces.sos_112: ʻAʻole i hōʻike ʻia kāu ʻāina: ma kahi kelepona paʻalima, hana ka 112 i nā ʻāina he nui. E nānā i ka helu o kou wahi i ka wā e hiki ai iā ʻoe.
s.p.espaces.sos_phr: Hōʻike a i ʻole pāʻani mele
s.p.espaces.sos_phr_sub: Hoʻololi ʻia nā hua'ōlelo i ka ʻōlelo o ka ʻāina i koho ʻia.
s.p.espaces.sp4: I loko o ka maʻi wau.
s.p.espaces.sp5: He aha ka maʻi ahulau e pili ana?
s.p.espaces.sos_med: 🩺 I ka mea lapaʻau a i ʻole ka hale kūʻai
s.p.espaces.sos_med_sub: ʻAʻole ia he 'ōlelo aʻoaʻo lapaʻau kēia.
s.p.espaces.hp2: He maʻi au i kēia lāʻau.
s.p.espaces.hp3: Ua lawe wau i kēia mālama i kēlā me kēia lā.
s.p.espaces.hp6: ʻAʻole au i ʻike. Hiki iā ʻoe ke kākau iā ia, lana ka manaʻo?
s.p.espaces.sos_offline: ʻAʻole hiki ke hoʻololi i nā hua'ōlelo me ka ʻole o kahi pilina: hōʻike i nā helu ma luna.
s.p.papier.title: 📄 E hoʻomaopopo i kahi palapala
s.p.papier.sub: E kiʻi i kahi kiʻi o kahi leka, ka lāʻau lapaʻau, ka palapala a i ʻole ka hōʻailona: e heluhelu iā ia ma kāu'ōlelo.
s.p.papier.private: E noho ana ka kiʻi ma kāu kelepona. ʻO ka hua'ōlelo wale nō i heluhelu ʻia e hoʻouna ʻia i ka lawelawe unuhi manuahi.
s.p.papier.first: Ka manawa mua no kēia ʻōlelo: hoʻoiho ka kelepona i kāna ʻike heluhelu (he mau MB).
s.p.papier.read_t: Ka hua'ōlelo i heluhelu ʻia (hoʻoponopono inā pono)
s.p.papier.none: ʻAʻohe hua'ōlelo i loaʻa. E kiʻi hou i ka kiʻi, paʻa a me nā kukui hou aku.
s.p.papier.e_lib: ʻAʻole hiki ke hoʻomaka i ka heluhelu: pono ka pūnaewele no ka manawa mua. E hoʻāʻo hou inā e hoʻopili ʻia.
s.p.papier.e_tr: ʻAʻole hiki ke hana i ka unuhi (hoʻopilikia 'ia ka pilina a iʻole he palena lā). E ho'āʻo hou.
s.p.papier.warn: Ka hoʻololi mīkini: no kahi palapala nui (kūkā, olakino, kālā, laikini noho), e nānā ʻia e kekahi o kāu mau hoaaloha a i ʻole kahi hui.
s.p.papier.help: E noi no ka kōkua ma Mutual aid
